newsitem.title: USA: ResMed, Compumedics say product cleared.
newsitem.headline: ResMed, Compumedics say product cleared.

text.p: ResMed Inc and Compumedics Pty Ltd, a medical equipment company based in Australia, on Thursday said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved the Compumedics P-Series and S-Series Sleep Systems.
In addition, the National Institutes of Health's Sleep Hearth Health Study has chosen the P-Series for use in a study of the effects of untreated sleep apnea on heart disease.

ResMed has exclusive distribution rights to the P-Series in the United States and other countries including Canada, France and Germany. It will begin marketing the P-Series and S-Series immediately, Resmed said.
